adapter.label: NHANES local/public-cache adapter

weightDomains.label: Interview participants
weightDomains.rationale: Use the interview survey weight when all variables come from the interview component.
weightDomains.eligibilityNote: interview participants with positive interview weights and complete analysis variables
weightDomains.multiCycleConstruction: Divide each 2-year interview weight by the number of combined 2-year cycles when pooling comparable cycles.

weightDomains.label: MEC exam participants
weightDomains.rationale: Use the MEC exam survey weight when any analysis variable comes from examination or laboratory components available to MEC participants.
weightDomains.eligibilityNote: MEC-exam participants with positive MEC weights and complete analysis variables
weightDomains.multiCycleConstruction: Divide each 2-year MEC weight by the number of combined 2-year cycles when pooling comparable cycles.

weightDomains.label: Morning fasting laboratory subsample
weightDomains.rationale: Use the fasting subsample survey weight when fasting laboratory measures are required.
weightDomains.eligibilityNote: fasting subsample-eligible participants with positive fasting subsample weights and complete analysis variables
leastCommonDenominatorFor: triglycerides when collected in the fasting subsample
weightDomains.multiCycleConstruction: Divide each 2-year fasting subsample weight by the number of combined 2-year cycles when pooling comparable cycles; do not mix with full-sample MEC weights.

weightDomains.label: 2017-2020 pre-pandemic fasting laboratory subsample
weightDomains.rationale: Use the pre-pandemic fasting subsample weight for 2017-2020 pre-pandemic fasting laboratory analyses.
weightDomains.eligibilityNote: 2017-2020 pre-pandemic fasting subsample-eligible participants with positive fasting weights and complete analysis variables
weightDomains.multiCycleConstruction: Treat as a special 2017-2020 pre-pandemic weight; do not divide like ordinary 2-year cycles unless a specific CDC-compatible pooling policy is declared.

weightDomains.label: 2017-2020 pre-pandemic MEC participants
weightDomains.rationale: Use the pre-pandemic MEC weight for 2017-2020 pre-pandemic MEC analyses.
weightDomains.eligibilityNote: 2017-2020 pre-pandemic MEC participants with positive MEC weights and complete analysis variables
leastCommonDenominatorFor: 2017-2020 pre-pandemic examination and standard laboratory variables
weightDomains.multiCycleConstruction: Treat as a special 2017-2020 pre-pandemic MEC weight; do not divide like ordinary 2-year cycles unless a specific CDC-compatible pooling policy is declared.

caveats: Cross-sectional design limits temporality and causality.
Subsample weights define narrower analytic populations.
Multi-cycle weight construction must be explicit.

evidence: Survey weight domains: WTINT2YR, WTMEC2YR, WTSAF2YR, WTSAFPRP, WTMECPRP.
